name: Naseem — نسيم
author: Sellchaze
description: A light, airy general-store theme: blue primary, generous whitespace, Arabic-first typography, sticky search header, category circles, product tabs, flash deals and a newsletter band — built entirely on the shared section library so every block is editable in the customizer.
changelog: 1.0.0 (2026-09-05): Initial release — first theme on the shared section library.
